title: (Updated) Create sales pitches with Copilot in PowerPoint
summary: A new Copilot skill in PowerPoint helps users create structured sales pitch presentations for various customer scenarios. It rolls out worldwide from late October to late November 2026 on Win32, Mac, and Web. No admin action or compliance concerns are required.
body:
Updated November 3, 2026: We have updated the timeline. Thank you for your patience. 

[What and Why:]

We are introducing a new Copilot skill in PowerPoint that helps users create customer-facing sales pitch presentations. Users can use this skill for scenarios such as a first customer meeting, warm-lead product introduction, industry-specific pitch, or internal sales enablement. The skill helps users shape a commercial story around the audience, opportunity, key messages, supporting evidence, and recommended next step.

[Rollout Schedule:]

General Availability (Worldwide): We began rolling in late October 2026 and expect to complete by late November 2026 (previously late October).

[Impact on Your Organization:]

Who is affected:

- Users with access to Copilot in PowerPoint.Platforms/Services:

- Microsoft 365 apps (PowerPoint on Win32, Mac, and Web)What will happen:

- Users will be able to use a scenario-specific skill to create more structured sales pitch presentation drafts.- This can help sales and customer-facing teams reduce the manual work needed to organize customer context, key messages, proof points, and next steps.[Action Required/Recommendations:]

No admin action is required. You may want to inform users that this new Copilot skill is becoming available in PowerPoint on Win32, Mac, and Web.

[Compliance considerations:]

No compliance considerations identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.
